name: rsk_getTransactionReceiptNodesByHash
summary: Returns the receipts-trie nodes proving a transaction receipt.
description: Returns the encoded trie nodes on the path between the receipt of the given transaction and the receipts-trie root of the given block, so that the receipt can be proved against the block header. The path is ordered **leaf first**: element 0 is the node holding the receipt and the last element is the root. Returns `null` when the transaction is not in that block.

result.name: receiptNodes
result.description: The encoded trie nodes proving the receipt, or `null` if the transaction is not in the block

oneOf.title: receiptNodes
oneOf.description: The encoded trie nodes, leaf first: element 0 holds the receipt, the last element is the receipts-trie root

examples.name: getTransactionReceiptNodesByHashExample
examples.description: The nodes are abridged; real trie nodes are longer
